reason: I already pay for magic apps, and a Hebrew one with several reveals (gallery, calculator, incoming call) is something I'd want in my collection. 99 shekels one-time is nothing for me, but I'd only pay after the free tricks actually fool my wife at home first.
objection: I'm not a magician, and if the reveal lags or looks fake at a party I look like an idiot. Also, installing from the browser instead of the App Store makes me wonder how polished and reliable it really is compared to the apps I already own.
would_change_my_mind: If the free tricks feel clunky or obviously staged when I test them, I'd walk away and stick with the apps I have.
